IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: A COOPERATIVE, ORGANIZED FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROMOTING THRIFT AND SAVINGS AMONG ITS MEMBERS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: CALIFORNIA COAST CREDIT UNION (CREDIT UNION) IS A COOPERATIVE, ORGANIZED FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROMOTING THRIFT AND SAVINGS AMONG ITS MEMBERS, CREATING A SOURCE OF CREDIT FOR THEM AT RATES OF INTEREST SET BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, AND PROVIDING AN OPPORTUNITY FOR THEM TO USE AND CONTROL THEIR OWN MONEY ON A DEMOCRATIC BASIS IN ORDER TO IMPROVE THEIR ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL CONDITION. AS A COOPERATIVE, THE CREDIT UNION CONDUCTS ITS BUSINESS FOR THE MUTUAL BENEFIT AND GENERAL WELFARE OF ITS MEMBERS WITH THE EARNINGS, SAVINGS, BENEFITS, OR SERVICES OF THE CREDIT UNION BEING DISTRIBUTED TO ITS MEMBERS AS PATRONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE ACCOUNTING MANAGER, AVP OF ACCOUNTING, AND THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER PRIOR TO FILING WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE. THE FORM 990 IS MADE AVAILABLE TO THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE FOR REVIEW AFTER FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, SUPERVISORY COMMITTEE, OFFICERS, VICE PRESIDENTS, SENIOR DIRECTORS, DIRECTORS, AND SENIOR MANAGERS ALL MUST COMPLETE AN ANNUAL QUESTIONNAIRE TO DISCLOSE ANY DIRECT CONFLICT AND/OR POTENTIAL CONFLICT THAT MAY ARISE WITH CALIFORNIA COAST CREDIT UNION (THE CREDIT UNION). AN ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST OCCURS WHEN A PERSON IS IN A POSITION TO INFLUENCE A DECISION THAT MAY RESULT IN PERSONAL GAIN FOR THAT EMPLOYEE OR FOR A RELATIVE OF THAT EMPLOYEE AS A RESULT OF THE CREDIT UNION'S BUSINESS DEALINGS. ANY PERSON INVOLVED THAT IS DEEMED TO HAVE A CONFLICT MUST IMMEDIATELY AND FULLY DISCLOSE THE CIRCUMSTANCES TO SENIOR MANAGEMENT OF THE EMPLOYEE'S BUSINESS UNIT OR PRESIDENT/CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER OF THE CREDIT UNION FOR A DETERMINATION AS TO WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS. IF AN ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS, THE CREDIT UNION MAY TAKE WHATEVER CORRECTIVE ACTION APPEARS APPROPRIATE ACCORDING TO THE CIRCUMSTANCES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: HUMAN RESOURCES GATHERS INFORMATION USING COMPENSATION SURVEYS AND USES 3RD PARTY DATA TO COMPARE COMPENSATION WITH SIMILARLY SITUATED PERSONS AT COMPARABLE ORGANIZATIONS. THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REVIEWS AND APPROVES THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER'S COMPENSATION PACKAGE EACH YEAR. THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER HAS A WRITTEN EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT. THE PROCESS OF DETERMINING THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER'S COMPENSATION IS CONTEMPORANEOUSLY DOCUMENTED IN THE BOARD MINUTES. THE LAST TIME THIS PROCESS OCCURRED WAS IN 2025.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CALIFORNIA COAST CREDIT UNION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST IN THE SAME TIME AND MANNER AS OTHER DISCLOSURES REQUIRED UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 6104.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART IV, LINE 12A & PART XII, LINE 2B:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CALIFORNIA COAST CREDIT UNION'S (THE CREDIT UNION) FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AUDITED ON A CONSOLIDATED BASIS BY AN INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTANT. HOWEVER, THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AUDITED ON A FISCAL YEAR-END BASIS OF MARCH 31ST, WHILE THE CREDIT UNION'S TAX YEAR-END IS DECEMBER 31ST.
